title: Understanding Decision Thresholds
text: The decision threshold in a logistic regression model determines the point at which you classify an observation as one class or another. Lowering the threshold means you are more likely to classify observations as the positive class.

title: Effect on Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions. Lowering the threshold can increase the number of positive predictions, but it may also increase the number of false positives.

title: Analyzing the Impact
text: Consider how lowering the threshold affects the balance between true positives and false positives. If false positives increase significantly, precision may decrease.

title: Conclusion on Precision
text: Lowering the threshold increases the number of positive predictions, which can lead to more false positives. This can decrease precision unless the increase in true positives is proportionally larger.
